title: 第1章 灵植园杂役第2章 极品聚气丹
content_zh:
“你叫什么？”
“徐长生。”
“长生？”问话的壮汉一愣，随即嗤笑了一声，“你父母对你倒是期望挺大的。长生久视，谁不想呢？可惜……是个五行灵根的废物！”
徐长生下意识握了一下拳头，随即，颓废的松开。
他父母都是清虚宗的外门弟子，耳濡目染之下，对修仙界的一些常识，自然也是知道的。
而且，在他八岁那年，父亲徐大海给他测试过灵根，五行灵根。
有灵根，便能吞吐天地灵气，进行修行，成为移山填海的大神通者。
可惜，五行灵根吸纳天地灵气的速度极慢。而且，想要突破下一层境界，需要五种灵根同时突破才可。
单一灵根修士，只需要炼化一种灵气，填满丹田，便可突破境界。
而五行灵根修士，需要将金、木、水、火、土，五种灵气，全部填满丹田，才可突破。
同样的修行资源，单一灵根修士可以修炼到练气五层，甚至六层。
而五行灵根修士，也就修炼到练气一层。
故此，五行灵根修士虽然也可修行，但却和凡人没什么两样。
徐长生苦修多年，如今也才练气一层罢了。
“罢了，既然常浩求到我头上，这面子我总是要给的。以后你就跟着我，在这天枢峰好好干。”
徐长生连连点头。
他父母虽是外门弟子，但已经在三年前的历练中，被妖兽杀死了。
人死茶凉，他虽然守着父母留下的小院，却根本无力生活，更遑论是修行。
常浩是他父亲的朋友，拖了关系，送了灵石，这才把他送入天枢峰外门。
虽然只是外门杂役，但好歹入了门不是？

只要勤快点，这日子总比凡人过的好一些。至少，能吸纳天地灵气，于追寻大道，有那么一丝丝渺茫的机会。
“咱们这天枢峰，有三个杂役班，我是班头，你可以喊我姜老大。”
“姜老大。”徐长生恭敬的喊了一声。
对他的态度还算满意，姜老大的脸色缓和了一些，“咱们日常的任务，就是照顾后山那一百亩的灵植园，你跟我来吧。”
“那些灵植很娇贵，必须精心伺候，有什么好歹，免不了被仙师们一顿责打。不过，此地灵气充裕，对我们这些底层杂役来说，也算是一种福利了。”
“这边是食堂，每日三餐定点供应，去晚了就没饭了。”
“这边是工具房，早上起来领工具，晚上睡觉的时候把工具还回去，那工具虽然看着不起眼，却都是灵器，丢了一个，都足够要了你的小命。”
“这边是你们休息的地方，八个人一个院子，每人一个房间，不许给我闹事，否则，立刻滚下山！”
灵植园外，有一片坐落有致的房子，姜老大一一给徐长生指点出来。
徐长生一边点头，一边用心记下。
到了灵植园，一股浓郁的香气，瞬间扑面而来，让人精神顿时一震。
姜老大指着一片花圃，对徐长生道：“这是玲珑花，是天璇峰炼丹需要的辅材，这种花喜阴，你的任务就是浇水，每隔一个时辰浇一次，如果浇的晚了，这花就会枯死，到时候，有你好受的。”
徐长生心头一凛，小心翼翼的问道：“那……晚上怎么办？”
“子时、丑时、寅时、夜深露重，不用浇水。”
徐长生松了口气。一天好歹能休息三个时辰。
“我刚刚说的，都记下了吧？”姜老大问道。
“记下了。”
“给你，这是聚气丹，每个杂役弟子，每月可领取三颗。”姜老大从百宝袋里掏出三颗黄豆大小的青色丹药，递给徐长生。
徐长生一愣。
他入门的时候可是听说，每个杂役弟子，每月都有十颗聚气丹。

这是被姜老大暗中克扣了七颗？
姜老大见徐长生愣住不动，目光渐渐冷了下来，低喝道：“徐长生！”
content_en:
"What's your name?"
"Xu Changsheng."
"Immortality?" The strong man who asked was stunned, and then sneered, "Your parents have great expectations for you. Who doesn't want to live forever? It's a pity... you are a waste with five elements of spiritual roots!"
Xu Changsheng clenched his fist subconsciously, and then loosened his fist in despair.
His parents were both outer disciples of the Qingxu Sect, so they naturally knew some common sense about the world of immortality.
Moreover, when he was eight years old, his father Xu Dahai tested his spiritual roots, the Five Elements Spiritual Roots.
If you have spiritual roots, you can absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, practice practice, and become a person with great supernatural powers who can move mountains and fill seas.
Unfortunately, the Five Elements Spiritual Root absorbs the spiritual energy of heaven and earth very slowly. Moreover, if you want to break through to the next level, you need five spiritual roots to break through at the same time.
Monks with a single spiritual root only need to refine one type of spiritual energy and fill their Dantian to achieve a breakthrough.
As for the Five Elements Spiritual Root cultivators, they need to fill their Dantian with all the five spiritual energies of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth before they can make a breakthrough.
With the same cultivation resources, a monk with a single spiritual root can cultivate to the fifth or even sixth level of Qi training.
The Five Elements Spiritual Root cultivators have only reached the level of Qi training.
Therefore, although monks with Five Elements Spiritual Roots can also practice cultivation, they are no different from ordinary people.
Xu Changsheng has been practicing hard for many years, and now he has only reached the first level of Qi training.
"That's all, since Chang Hao has begged me, I will always give him this face. From now on, you will follow me and do a good job in Tianshu Peak."
Xu Changsheng nodded repeatedly.
Although his parents were outer disciples, they were killed by monsters during their training three years ago.
After death, the tea was cold. Although he guarded the small courtyard left by his parents, he was unable to live at all, let alone practice.
Chang Hao was his father's friend, and he was sent to the outer gate of Tianshu Peak after dragging on the relationship and giving him spiritual stones.
Although he is just a handyman at the outer door, he has finally entered the door, right?
As long as you work hard, your life will be better than ordinary people. At least, being able to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and have a slim chance of pursuing the great road.
"We have three handyman classes in Tianshu Peak. I am the class leader. You can call me Boss Jiang."
"Boss Jiang." Xu Changsheng shouted respectfully.
Satisfied with his attitude, Boss Jiang's expression softened a little, "Our daily task is to take care of the one hundred acres of spiritual plant garden in the back mountain. Come with me."
"Those spiritual plants are very delicate and must be taken care of carefully. If there is any harm, they will inevitably be beaten by the immortal masters. However, the spiritual energy here is abundant, which is also a benefit for us low-level servants."
"This is the canteen. Three meals a day are served at fixed times. If you go late, you won't have any meals."
"This is the tool room. You get the tools when you get up in the morning and return them when you go to bed at night. Although the tools look inconspicuous, they are spiritual weapons. If you lose one, it can kill you."
"This is your resting place. There are eight people in one courtyard, and each person has a room. Don't make trouble for me, otherwise, get down the mountain immediately!"
Outside the Lingzhi Garden, there was a cluster of well-located houses. Boss Jiang pointed them out to Xu Changsheng one by one.
Xu Changsheng nodded and wrote it down carefully.
When we arrived at Lingzhi Garden, a strong aroma hit our face instantly, making people feel energetic.
Boss Jiang pointed to a flower bed and said to Xu Changsheng: "This is an exquisite flower, which is an auxiliary material needed for alchemy at Tianxuan Peak. This kind of flower likes shade. Your task is to water it, once every hour. If you water it too late, the flower will wither. When the time comes, you will feel better."
Xu Changsheng's heart trembled, and he asked cautiously: "Then... what should we do at night?"
"There is no need to water the water during Zi time, Chou time, Yin time, late at night and heavy dew."
Xu Changsheng breathed a sigh of relief. At least I can rest for three hours a day.
"Did you remember what I just said?" Boss Jiang asked.
"Noted it down."
"Here you go,This is Qi Gathering Pill, and each handyman disciple can receive three pills every month. "Boss Jiang took out three soybean-sized green elixirs from his treasure bag and handed them to Xu Changsheng.
Xu Changsheng was stunned.
When he started, he heard that every handyman disciple had ten Qi Gathering Pills every month.
Was this seven pills secretly withheld by Boss Jiang?
Seeing that Xu Changsheng was stunned, Boss Jiang's eyes gradually turned cold and he shouted in a low voice: "Xu Changsheng! "
